full_judgment: 24. The law of limitation is stringent and it cannot be interfered with however exigent the demand may be. Therefore, according to us, the law demands that the computation of the statutory period in the instant case will start from the date of revival i.e. from 29.7.90 which according to sub-section 5 of section 339D is deemed to be the date on which the case is received for trial. On that basis it seems that the statutory period of 240 working days was over on 20.6.91 as is calculated by the learned Advocate for the petitioner and not controverted by the State. In such circumstances, section 339D(4) will come into effect with consequent stoppage of further proceeding of the case and the release of the accused persons.
